fixed_rules.signals: F02/F04/OVERNIGHT_PAIR preserved from frozen pilot Top10; no refit or re-ranking
fixed_rules.entry: use existing pilot first eligible minute-bar OPEN at/after 09:01 or 09:05
fixed_rules.exit_B: latest observed traded 1-minute bar starting 13:20-13:24; use that bar CLOSE; this is the final continuous-session trade-price proxy before closing call auction
fixed_rules.cost_model: fee_one_way=0.1425%; sell_tax=0.3%; one-way slippage sensitivity 10/20/30/50bp charged on both sides
fixed_rules.volume_unit: Fugle documentation: ordinary listed/OTC stock minute-K volume is in lots; emerging-stock volume is in shares. Raw unit is retained; instrument type must be respected.

limits: This is an exit-price robustness diagnostic, not a new independent validation or trading approval.
All minute-bar OPEN/CLOSE prices are proxies and do not prove an order was filled.
No bid/ask, queue, order-book depth, partial fills, minimum commission, or impact model is available.
Entry eligibility is restricted to <=5 minutes after the preset 09:01/09:05 clock; excluded names remain in selected-row coverage denominator.

Exit B is the latest observed minute-bar CLOSE from the final continuous-session window (13:20-13:24); bar prices are proxies, not guaranteed fills. The 13:25-13:30 closing call auction is not continuous trading.
TWSE continuous trading is 09:00-13:25; 13:25-13:30 is closing call auction. Exit B therefore uses the final continuous-session minute bars, not bars during the auction.
20 signal dates are a small exploratory sample already inspected in prior SSO work; no multiple-testing correction is performed here.
Daily Top10 cohorts are not a compounded capital-account backtest.
